questions.stem: Explain how the probability axioms are used to calculate the probability of a compound event.
markingGuide: Identify the probability axioms: non-negativity, normalization, additivity.

questions.stem: A die is rolled twice. What is the probability of rolling a 4 on the first roll and an even number on the second roll?
questions.explanation: The probability of rolling a 4 on the first roll is $\frac{1}{6}$, and rolling an even number (2, 4, 6) on the second roll is $\frac{3}{6}$. The combined probability is $\frac{1}{6} \times \frac{3}{6} = \frac{1}{12}$.
